Description: CloudWatch Dashboards to visualize CloudFront distributions. Both dashboards leverage Dashboard Variables to filter on the desired resources. Dashboard 'CloudFront_All_Resources' visualizes ALL CloudFront distributions in the target region. Dashboard 'CloudFront_Individual_Resources' provides additional filters to isolate a specific CloudFront distribution.

DefaultRegion.Description: Select the default region hosting the CloudFront distributions to be monitored.

DefaultDistributionId.Description: Select the default CloudFront distribution ID to be monitored (e.g. E1234567890ABC).)

DefaultFunctionName.Description: Select the default Lambda@Edge function name to be monitored.
